title: Syzygy-word parity and the angular-momentum holonomy obstruction
exact_target: Determine which three-body syzygy symbol sequences are realizable, minimizing, and compatible with zero angular momentum.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002537 (AIM-PHYSICS-0045). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 8.

status_qualification: The source does not fix finite versus infinite or periodic symbol sequences, repetitions, endpoints or collision treatment. Such choices must be supplied in a theorem and identified as a clarified scope, not silently asserted for all conceivable sequences. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
